open_items: GAP SPEC, filed 2026-07-16 (operator 2026-07-15 night): staged remediation — restore service (bounded/reversible) -> investigate (read-mostly, FailureFinding binds diagnosis to evidence) -> prevent recurrence (classified paths only), EACH stage its own grant, EACH transition demands the prior stage's witness (RecoveryReceipt / FailureFinding / DeploymentReceipt).
